name: Wine
use: Wine 4.0.4: the DLLs, programs, tools and server the Wine demo builds in Dolly, with demos/wine/wine-dolly.patch applied and its Bison and flex parsers generated

name: ReactOS Paint
use: Paint of ReactOS 0.3.17 (base/applications/mspaint, C), built in Dolly against Wine's headers and DLLs as the Wine demo's Paint

name: Dolly's Wine port files
use: The loader, platform, server and display driver files compiled into Wine, and its winebuild backend

name: TinyCC
use: TinyCC 0.9.27's win64 binary release, unmodified: x86-64 Windows code that the Wine demo's x86emu interprets, and the compiler that builds the image's x86-64 sample from its own example; its source release is in the same archive

name: NetSurf
use: NetSurf 3.11 with its Windows front end, and the libraries of the same release (libcss, libdom, libhubbub, libparserutils, libwapcaplet, libnsbmp, libnsgif, libnsutils, libnspsl with the Public Suffix List, libutf8proc with Unicode data): the Wine demo's web browser, built in Dolly with demos/wine/netsurf-dolly.patch applied; GPL-2.0-only with the OpenSSL linking exception of its COPYING, the libraries MIT
licence: GPL-2.0-only AND MIT AND MPL-2.0 AND Unicode-DFS-2016

name: Pango
use: Pango 1.14.10 with its Windows backend (GDI fonts) for GTK+, built against the Wine demo's Winelib, and its FreeType backend for GIMP's text, whose OpenType code (HarfBuzz of 2006) is taken under its GPL option

name: GTK+
use: GTK+ 2.6.10 with gdk-pixbuf and GDK's Windows backend, built against the Wine demo's Winelib with demos/wine/gimp-dolly.patch applied

name: GIMP
use: GIMP 2.2.17: the program with its libgimp libraries, brushes, gradients, palettes, patterns, icons and menus, built in Dolly as a program of the Wine demo with demos/wine/gimp-dolly.patch applied; no plug-ins, scripts or help are built

name: libart
use: libart_lgpl 2.3.17, which fills and strokes GIMP's paths

name: fontconfig
use: fontconfig 2.3.2, which finds the fonts of GIMP's text; two functions that read fonts through FreeType's internals are patched to its public calls

name: gperf
use: Generates libhubbub's table of element names outside Dolly; only its output ships

name: libjpeg (IJG)
use: JPEG images in the Wine demo's NetSurf: this software is based in part on the work of the Independent JPEG Group
